chosenStory: Pandora Raises 2026 Outlook as U.S. Sales Rebound
whyThisStory: Pandora’s sales rebound offers a recognisable jewellery-world setup with a physical punchline, unlike the broader growth report or the less cover-friendly logistics and delivery stories.
secondaryEnhancer: implied motion or just happened moment
sceneDescription: A jewellery case has sprung open like a jack-in-the-box, raising its bracelet cushion on a spring: Pandora’s sales rebound has apparently reached the presentation boxes. On a pale oak private viewing desk, an open ivory leather bracelet case contains one unexpectedly extended steel coil supporting its linen insert, with a plain silver charm bracelet securely wrapped around it. The lid rests tipped back behind the spring. Everything else is quietly respectable, and nobody is present.
finalImagePrompt: A jeweller’s private viewing desk in daylight, pale oak beneath a plain limestone wall. In the middle of the frame, lower half, a small open ivory leather bracelet case has a stout steel spring extending from its base, lifting its linen cushion like a jack-in-the-box. A silver bracelet with plain silver charms encircles the cushion. The case occupies less than a third of the width. Slight leather wear, natural shadows, no writing, no people.
